head: 05777d2ef03e436eab887706b2a99164aee92c35
change_summary: add the shared hub-executor execution_guard owner for process lifetime and bounded output capture
kill and confirm the ordinary Unix process group after the direct parent exits, before output collection
replace unbounded reader joins with one independent shared one-second stdout/stderr drain deadline
fail closed with an explicit incomplete-stream backend error on reader failure, disconnect or drain expiry
persist only executable basename, environment variable names and the OS error on spawn failure; omit argv, environment values and the full executable path

discarded_attempts.reason: rustfmt differences; later validation steps were skipped and the run was not counted

premerge_validation.local_note: git diff --check passed; cargo was unavailable in the automation runtime, so no local Rust validation is claimed

acceptance: ordinary in-group descendants are killed and group termination is confirmed before drains after parent exit
stdout and stderr drains share a deadline independent from the entrypoint timeout
capture incompleteness is reported as a bounded fail-closed backend event
spawn errors include OS error, binary identifier and environment names but no argv, environment values or Debug(Command)
the exact PR head and exact integrated target commit passed every configured validation
limitations: processes that deliberately leave the dedicated process group remain outside the claimed supervision boundary
ProcessExecutor remains resource supervision and is not an OS security sandbox
